links.comparator_used: Initial prompt for Llama3-8b before prompt engineering on the 600 pilot cases
links.outcome: Match-score for annotating Danish trauma radiology reports (Llama3-8b)
links.quote: Prompt engineering improved the  Match -score for Llama3-8b from 77.8% (95% CI: 74.4% – 81.1%) to 94.3% (95% CI: 92.5% – 96.2%).
